item.title: The Quiet Machine
item.description:
Because status is Reading, this book floats to the front of the shelf, gets an accent ring and a badge on the grid, and shows a “Reading now” marker here.

It has no rating, so the stars are omitted entirely rather than rendered empty — a book you have not finished has not been judged yet.

item.title: SnapSweeper - Prototype & Development Process
item.description:
SnapSweeper Design

Photos. Videos. It All Adds Up. Keep Swiping and Earn Achievements.

PhotoSwipe provides an easy to use interface, showing you where you have the most media and helping you declutter fast. As you continue to use SnapSweeper, you’ll unlock more achievements. Keep exploring the app to find more!

PhotoSwipe

Featured in SnapSweeper, PhotoSwipe allows you to act fast on your photo library. Swipe left to mark an item for deletion. A swipe in the right direction moves on to the next piece. Take advantage of the beautiful Liquid Glass redesign available on devices running iOS 26 or later.

item.title: The Pragmatic Shelf
item.description:
A finished book with a full rating and a Goodreads link. The cover, the stars, the facts list and the link all sit in the column a post would use for its table of contents, and your notes run full width underneath.

Notes

Headings work in book notes exactly as they do in a post, so a long set of notes can be structured rather than one block of prose.

item.title: Example Professional Certification
item.description:
The body of a certification page is ordinary Markdown, so this is the place for what the credential actually meant rather than what the syllabus said.

Everything else on this page — the issuer kicker, the badge, the dates, the facts list and the verify button — comes from the certMeta block in the front matter.

item.title: Notes on Simplicity
item.description: Three stars out of five, no ISBN and no Goodreads link — so this page shows the partial star row and the shorter facts list you get when you only fill in what you actually know.

item.title: Example Associate Certification
item.description: This one has no expiryDate, so the Expires row is simply absent — every fact in the list is optional and disappears when you omit it.

item.title: Example Foundations Certification
item.description:
A second issuer, so the list page has two groups to sort. Issuers are ordered by their most recent credential, which puts the track you are actively certifying on above the ones you have moved past.

This credential is also marked Expired and has no credentialUrl, so it loses the accent status pill and the verify button.

item.title: About
item.description:
This is the About layout. It puts your prose and a couple of summary rows in the left column, and a portrait with a row of social icons on the right.

params.portrait is deliberately unset on this demo site, so what you see to the right is the empty frame. Point it at any image under assets/ or static/ and the theme resizes it to 800px wide, converts it to WebP, and emits real dimensions so the page never shifts as it loads.

item.title: Resume
item.description: This page’s content is only used as a fallback. When data/resume.yaml exists the theme renders that instead, and this prose is ignored.
